verdict.rationale: Steel has no first-party natural-language command interface. Instead, you control it in plain language through third-party agents: a steel-browser skill for coding agents, MCP tools exposed to any MCP client, and integrations with Claude, OpenAI and Gemini Computer Use, Browser-Use and other agent frameworks. Natural-language operation therefore depends on bringing your own LLM agent, while the product itself is driven by API and CLI commands. Missing for 10: a native natural-language command interface in Steel itself, and independent or hands-on corroboration of how well natural-language control works.
